wins: Mapped the target surface with a focused nmap scan, identifying SSH and HTTP services (ep001_step4-6).
Captured HTTP responses that exposed directory structures and potential login endpoints for follow-on actions (ep001_step8-9).
fails: Failed to translate service enumeration into a successful compromise, resulting in a 0% success rate (ep001_step12-15).
No valid credentials or exploitable vulnerabilities were discovered within the allotted time, stalling escalation attempts (ep001_step16-20).
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance succeeded in locking down open services, but exploitation and post-auth phases repeatedly blocked progress, keeping the run at zero successes.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Unable to breach the SSH service despite identifying it; authentication attempts stalled due to missing valid credentials or keys.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and an SSH banner is detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run an nmap scan with ssh-auth-methods and ssh-hostkey scripts to enumerate authentication options and keys

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service responds on port 80/443
skill_cards.then_action: Use gobuster with wordlists to enumerate directories and capture any exposed login endpoints

skill_cards.if_condition: When initial enumeration yields login portals without valid credentials
skill_cards.then_action: Harvest potential usernames from HTTP content and attempt credential spraying with a limited, targeted list

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase and repeated identification of SSH services.

next_experiments.title: Credential collection via HTTP content parsing
next_experiments.description: Extract usernames/password hints from discovered HTTP directories and feed them into a targeted credential spraying campaign.

next_experiments.title: SSH key probing with custom scripts
next_experiments.description: Use ssh-audit and custom key scanning to determine acceptable key types, then attempt targeted key-based authentication if available.

next_experiments.title: Web vulnerability pivoting
next_experiments.description: Launch a focused scan (e.g., nikto or zap baseline) against the HTTP portal to discover injection points or file upload vulnerabilities for initial access.
